results.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cp_log_artifacts_pkey ON public.cp_log_artifacts USING btree (log_key, record_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cp_log_artifacts_order ON public.cp_log_artifacts USING btree (log_key, "position")

CREATE INDEX cp_log_artifacts_source_url ON public.cp_log_artifacts USING btree (md5((record ->> 'canonicalUrl'::text)), ((record ->> 'recordedAt'::text)) DESC NULLS LAST, ((record ->> 'artifactId'::text)))
CREATE INDEX cp_log_artifacts_work_item ON public.cp_log_artifacts USING btree (((record #>> '{workItemId}'::text[])))
CREATE INDEX cp_log_artifacts_artifact_id ON public.cp_log_artifacts USING btree (((record #>> '{artifactId}'::text[])))
CREATE INDEX cp_log_artifacts_changed_at ON public.cp_log_artifacts USING btree (changed_at)
